components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact primary command for save, copy, and high-value actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 32px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--melt-accent, #f2af0d); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--melt-accent, #f2af0d); color: var(--melt-frame, #0c0c0e); padding: 0 12px; font-family: Aptos, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--melt-accent-hover, #ffc130); border-color: var(--melt-accent-hover, #ffc130); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(227,178,91,0.18); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet command for export, import, refresh, and secondary utilities.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 32px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--melt-text-muted, #71717a) 15%, transparent); border-radius: 6px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--melt-surface, #18181b) 30%, transparent); color: var(--melt-text-heading, #e4e4e7); padding: 0 12px; font-family: Aptos, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out, background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--melt-accent, #f2af0d) 30%, transparent); color: var(--melt-accent, #f2af0d); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(227,178,91,0.12); }

components.name: Select Field
components.description: Compact option control used throughout the studio panels.
components.css: .ds-select-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 120px 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: var(--melt-text-label, #a1a1aa); font-family: Aptos, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .025em; } .ds-select-row select { height: 32px; width: 100%; appearance: none; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--melt-text-muted, #71717a) 15%, transparent); border-radius: 6px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--melt-frame, #0c0c0e) 70%, transparent); color: var(--melt-text-heading, #e4e4e7); padding: 0 28px 0 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, background 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-select-row select:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--melt-text-muted, #71717a) 30%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--melt-frame, #0c0c0e) 90%, transparent); } .ds-select-row select:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--melt-accent, #f2af0d) 60%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(227,178,91,0.12); }

components.name: Range Field
components.description: Precision slider row with label, range track, and numeric value.
components.css: .ds-range-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 120px 1fr 64px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: var(--melt-text-label, #a1a1aa); font-family: Aptos, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .025em; } .ds-range-row input[type='range'] { width: 100%; height: 8px; accent-color: var(--melt-accent, #f2af0d); } .ds-range-row input[type='number'] { height: 28px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--melt-text-muted, #71717a) 15%, transparent); border-radius: 4px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--melt-frame, #0c0c0e) 60%, transparent); color: var(--melt-text-heading, #e4e4e7); padding: 0 8px; text-align: right; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 11px; } .ds-range-row input[type='number']:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--melt-accent, #f2af0d) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Tiny broadcast status marker for API, Streamer.bot, loading, and selected states.
components.css: .ds-status-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(52,211,153,0.25); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(52,211,153,0.10); color: #a7f3d0; padding: 0 10px; font-family: Aptos, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Tool-rail navigation item with active accent fill and compact label.
components.html: Lighting
components.css: .ds-nav-item { height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--melt-accent, #f2af0d); color: var(--melt-frame, #0c0c0e); padding: 0 12px; text-decoration: none; font-family: Aptos, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.28em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform 450ms cubic-bezier(0.455,0.03,0.515,0.955); } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex: none; transform: rotate(-10deg) scale(1.2); } .ds-nav-item:hover { transform: translateX(2px); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(227,178,91,0.18); }

components.name: Code Block
components.description: Compact URL, preset id, or generated value block.
components.css: .ds-code-block { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--melt-text-muted, #71717a) 15%, transparent); border-radius: 6px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--melt-frame, #0c0c0e) 60%, transparent); color: var(--melt-text-heading, #e4e4e7); padding: 8px 12px; font-family: Aptos, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-code-block div { color: var(--melt-text-muted, #71717a); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-code-block code { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: var(--melt-text-heading, #e4e4e7); font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 11px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

components.name: Preset Card
components.description: Selectable compact row for saved or built-in stream looks.
components.css: .ds-preset-card { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--melt-accent, #f2af0d) 40%, transparent); border-radius: 8px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--melt-accent, #f2af0d) 10%, transparent); padding: 10px 12px; font-family: Aptos, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-preset-card strong { display: block; color: var(--melt-text-heading, #e4e4e7); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-preset-card code { display: block; margin-top: 2px; color: var(--melt-text-muted, #71717a); font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 10px; } .ds-preset-card span { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--melt-accent, #f2af0d) 25%, transparent); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--melt-accent, #f2af0d); padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Social Link
components.description: Higher-energy creator support link, reserved for support and community surfaces.
components.css: .ds-social-link { position: relative; height: 52px; width: 220px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 16px; color: var(--melt-text-label, #a1a1aa); text-decoration: none; font-family: Aptos, 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: color 300ms ease-out, background 300ms ease-out; } .ds-social-link svg { position: absolute; left: 16px; width: 18px; height: 18px; color: var(--melt-accent, #f2af0d); transform: scale(1.55); transition: left 500ms ease-out, transform 500ms ease-out, color 300ms ease-out; } .ds-social-link span { margin-left: auto; margin-right: 24px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.3em; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: .8; transition: transform 400ms ease-out, opacity 400ms ease-out; } .ds-social-link:hover { background: var(--melt-accent, #f2af0d); color: var(--melt-surface, #18181b); } .ds-social-link:hover svg { left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1.55) rotate(-8deg); color: var(--melt-surface, #18181b); } .ds-social-link:hover span { transform: translateX(40px); opacity: 0; }

narrative.overview:
The studio should feel like a focused broadcast lab for shaping light, not a generic settings page. The surface is dark, compact, and operational so the overlay remains the visual star. Warm amber and optional cobalt accents behave like instrument lights: rare, directional, and tied to selection, status, and decisive actions.

This is a product tool first. It should make first-time setup clear, keep deep customization organized, and preserve the premium feel of the output without burying advanced controls behind decoration. Personality comes from the Melty mark, motion details, compact typography, and the light-focused preview language, not from novelty holiday styling.

The system explicitly rejects generic SaaS dashboards, sterile admin panels, outdated OBS plugin interfaces, overly cute holiday toy styling, cluttered novelty controls, and visual treatments that make the UI look heavier than the overlay it controls.
keyCharacteristics: Dark graphite and slate layers with a single active accent.
Compact uppercase labels, small numeric fields, and clear live-status affordances.
Creator-first workflows: preview, presets, OBS, Streamer.bot, save, export.

rules.name: The Instrument Light Rule
rules.body: Accent color marks active state, command, focus, or status. It is not page decoration.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Amber and cobalt are theme alternatives. Do not use both as competing accents in one studio surface unless the second color is data or external brand color.

rules.name: The Preview First Rule
rules.body: The control UI stays darker and quieter than the live overlay preview, so the creator keeps attention on the stream output.

rules.name: The Dense Label Rule
rules.body: Labels may be small only when they are heavy, tracked, and placed in consistent rows. Tiny weak labels are forbidden.

rules.name: The No Hero Type Rule
rules.body: This product UI does not use landing-page scale typography inside the studio. Large expressive type belongs to a later brand pass.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Prefer darker or lighter surface steps, 1px borders, and selected fills before reaching for a shadow.

rules.name: The Glow Is State Rule
rules.body: Glow must communicate active, selected, live, or focused state. Decorative glow is prohibited.

dos: Do keep the studio a product tool first: fast to understand, dense enough for real control, and calm enough for repeated use.
Do make first-run setup obvious before exposing every deep customization path.
Do use Signal Ember or Control Cobalt for active state, command, focus, and status.
Do preserve numeric precision beside sliders.
Do keep the live preview visible, resizable, and visually quieter than the overlay itself.
Do keep animation short, responsive, and tied to state changes.
Do keep keyboard focus visible on every interactive control.
donts: Don't make this look like a generic SaaS dashboard.
Don't make this feel like a sterile admin panel.
Don't imitate outdated OBS plugin interfaces.
Don't lean into overly cute holiday toy styling.
Don't use visual treatments that make the UI look heavier than the overlay it controls.
Don't sacrifice clarity, performance, or control density for personality.
Don't make advanced users dig through decorative surfaces to reach real settings.
Don't use colored side-stripe borders greater than 1px as card accents.
Don't use gradient text, decorative glassmorphism, or repeated identical card grids.
